title: 质量评估对比基础模型

standard.summary: 质量评估时用 LoRA 权重 0 与 1 各生成一组样本（同 prompt 同 seed），产出「底模 vs 训练产物」的成对增量证据。默认开启。
standard.effect: 每个验证用例生成两份图：一份关闭 LoRA（权重 0）、一份开启（权重 1），指标分别计算，报告能回答「LoRA 究竟带来了多少变化」。
standard.whenToUse: 想确认训练真的产生了预期改变、而不是把底模本来就会的东西归功于 LoRA 时；写训练报告需要 before/after 证据时。
standard.avoidWhen: 评估时间预算紧张时可关闭（采样量减半）；quality_evaluation_enabled 关闭时无效。

standard_en.summary: During quality evaluation it generates one set of samples at LoRA weight 0 and one at weight 1 (same prompt, same seed), producing paired before-and-after evidence of the base model against the trained artefact. On by default.
standard_en.effect: Each validation case produces two images: one with the LoRA off (weight 0) and one with it on (weight 1), with the metrics computed separately, so the report can answer how much the LoRA actually changed.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want to confirm that training really produced the change you expected rather than crediting the LoRA with what the base model could already do; when a training report needs before/after evidence.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Turn it off when the evaluation time budget is tight (it halves the sampling); it has no effect while quality_evaluation_enabled is off.

advanced.principle: 绝对分数受底模水平主导，无法区分「LoRA 的贡献」与「底模的底子」；固定 prompt/seed 下的成对对照消去了底模与采样随机性两个混杂变量，是最小成本的因果证据。
advanced.intervention: quality/validation_suite.py：compare_base=bool(quality_evaluation_compare_base) 进入套件定义，评估执行时按 LoRA scale 0/1 两次采样。
advanced.expectedImpact: 评估采样成本翻倍；报告增加逐用例的增量维度。
advanced.tradeoffs: 权重 0/1 的两点对照不覆盖中间权重的行为；如需权重扫描请配合 XY 网格功能。
advanced.codePath: quality/validation_suite.py：compare_base 读取；configs_validators.py：quality_evaluation 块 compare_base 归一化

advanced_en.principle: Absolute scores are dominated by the base model's level and cannot separate "the LoRA's contribution" from "the base model's foundation"; a paired comparison at fixed prompt/seed removes both confounders — base model and sampling randomness — and is the cheapest causal evidence.
advanced_en.intervention: quality/validation_suite.py: compare_base=bool(quality_evaluation_compare_base) enters the suite definition, and evaluation samples twice at LoRA scale 0/1.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Evaluation sampling cost doubles; the report gains a per-case delta dimension.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The two-point scale 0/1 comparison does not cover intermediate-weight behavior; use the XY grid feature for a weight sweep.
advanced_en.codePath: quality/validation_suite.py: compare_base read; configs_validators.py: quality_evaluation block compare_base normalization
